note: Sprite groups: name -> frame count (frames are <name>_1..N), sizes, anchors per frame and their meaning, suggested ms per frame. Anchors are the point that goes on the given world position; mirror around the anchor for a left-facing hero.

naming.hero_ward_frames: <set>_ward_<raise|hold|drop>_right_<n> (raise 4, hold 4 loop, drop 3), set = hero2 (katana) | totoy_dagger | totoy_scythe. Hero frames: the idle body with the slab; anchor = the matching idle frame's anchor (idle_frame lists it), left = right mirrored by the anchor.
naming.overlays:
fx_echo_shield__

, fx_sprint_aura__

, fx_sprint_after__, where F is the hero frame being drawn (hero2_*, totoy_dagger_*, totoy_scythe_*: idle_right_1..4, walk_right_1..6, dash_right_1..4). Cropped; draw by the overlay's own anchor at the hero's feet with the hero's mirroring. Phase timed from the aspect's start (shield 70 ms, aura 80 ms), independent of the hero frame. Afterimage k is drawn behind the hero where he was k x ~150 ms ago, or at behind_px against his facing. Missing name (attack, parry, hurt, victory, coil, lightning frames): draw none; for Echo Step use fx_echo_bubble.
naming.icons: ui_aspect_<echo_step|stone_ward|sprint>_1 (24x24), ui_aspect_<key>_lit_1..4 optional HUD loop while active (~120 ms)
